name: Ayasato-ke no Ichizoku
source:
It is the underworld of "Ace Attorney"... A medium returns to Wright, who continues to fight daily with Mia's death in his heart. And then, the lewdness begins...!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ021991.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
這裡是《逆轉裁判》的另一面……成步堂心裡一直記著千尋的死，每天繼續奮戰。一名靈媒回到了他的身邊，淫亂的一幕就此展開……！

[譯自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ021991.html]DLsite[/url]]
